## Trust / Audit

Risk notes: Use `ljagiello/ctf-skills` only for authorized CTF, lab, and security-research work. Its audit found MIT licensing and responsible-use framing, but also offensive-security workflows, write-capable permissions, and a broad local installer that can invoke `pip`, `apt`, `brew`, `gem`, `go`, and possibly `sudo`; run the installer dry-run before executing it.

## Purpose

From ljagiello/ctf-skills repo: agent skills for CTF categories. solve-challenge covers techniques from writeups (e.g. ai-ml: adversarial, jailbreaks, model extraction; pwn/reverse: binary; web: exploitation; etc). Includes scripts/ for env. MIT license stated, SECURITY.md with responsible use. Use only for authorized CTF/lab/security-research.
